type [required]

enum

Type of the investigation resource. Allowed enum values: investigations

default: investigations

meta [required]

object

Metadata of a page of investigations.

reason

enum

Why filter[signal_id] returned no investigation. Set only on the first page of an empty result. The reason is based on the organization's current settings. Poll again only on investigation_not_started, after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header; treat the others as final for this signal.

  • investigation_not_started: no investigation has started yet, but one may still start.
  • not_investigated: no investigation started within an hour of the signal, so none is expected. The signal was skipped for a reason this API doesn't report, such as its severity or a rate limit.
  • rule_not_enabled: the signal's detection rule doesn't have Bits Security Analyst enabled, so no investigation starts automatically.
  • signal_not_found: the ID isn't a signal ID, or no signal with this ID exists in the organization.
  • org_not_activated: the organization hasn't activated Bits Security Analyst. Allowed enum values: investigation_not_started,not_investigated,rule_not_enabled,signal_not_found,org_not_activated

total_count [required]

int64

Without filter[signal_id], the number of signals that match the filters. With filter[signal_id], the number of investigations of that signal. Pages past the last page return 0.

attributes.conclusion: The login came from a location the user travels to regularly, on a known device.

key_evidence.finding: The user logged in from the same country three times in the last 30 days.
source_steps: Has the user logged in from this location before?

mitigation_suggestions.rationale: Only needed if the user doesn't confirm the login.
mitigation_suggestions.title: Suspend the user

rule_tuning_suggestions.reasoning: Most signals from this rule in the last 30 days were benign travel.
rule_tuning_suggestions.rule_name: Unusual login location for a user

suggestions.description: Don't generate signals for logins from devices the user has used before.
suggestions.title: Suppress logins from known devices
suggestions.warning: A stolen known device would no longer trigger this rule.
suggestions.why: The user's known devices accounted for most benign signals.

rule_tuning_suggestions.summary: The rule fires often for users who travel to known locations.
